audit.whatIsWrong: Three level-chart rows render two different answers: full phases[4].side=Akali vs content win[4]=Azir; phases[5].side=Skill vs win[5]=Akali; phases[6].side=Skill vs win[6]=Azir.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Akali, Akali, Skill, Skill, Azir, Akali, Azir — it agrees with the content layer, so the full layer is the stale one. I could only ground one of the three: at 2+ items both whys already argue Azir (R cuts the fight, soldiers melt, late item scaling), so Skill there is simply wrong.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side moved to Azir with rating and why rewritten in the same proposal. Rows 4 and 5 left alone deliberately — see notes and questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and content.mid both called Akali's ultimate "Shadow Dance", and spikes[1] called Azir's ultimate "Shurima's Legacy". whys[5] repeated "Shadow Dance".
audit.why: Akali's R is Perfect Execution (120/90/60, 675 range, recast executes). Shurima's Legacy is Azir's PASSIVE — the Disc of the Sun from turret ruins. His wall is Emperor's Divide.
audit.corrected: All three renamed and rebuilt around the real numbers: two dashes, 675 range, execute on the recast, 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Assassin's Mark was mentioned but never explained, and the page attributed "mark damage ignores your soldier positioning" and a "Shroud heal" to Akali. Neither is in her kit.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: spell damage creates a ring; EXITING the ring empowers her next attack with bonus range and damage. That bonus range is what actually beats soldier spacing, and it is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell. Twilight Shroud grants invisibility and unselectability, no healing.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text rebuilt on the real ring-exit mechanic; dosFull[0].d now teaches the auto-reset wind-up as the step-back cue; spikes[2].text drops the invented Shroud heal for the real 18s shroud cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit anywhere (catalogue defect 3), and dosFull[2].d called Twilight Shroud a "fifteen-second" window.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16, Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Perfect Execution 120/90/60, Five Point Strike a flat 1.5s at 110 energy rank 1, Azir E 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t, breakdown.early and ahead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Perfect Execution's execute threshold was never stated, so the page told the reader to watch a health bar.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule execute-threshold for this matchup; Riot's recast text executes all enemies struck.
audit.corrected: breakdown.feeding now says track the number, not the bar.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t ended "Add anti-heal early into his sustain."
audit.why: Akali has no heal, drain or lifesteal in her kit — nothing carries the heal flag. Grievous Wounds buys nothing here, and the pronoun was wrong on top of it.

notes: Left phases[4] (Level 6) and phases[5] (First item) alone even though full and content disagree on both. The full layer says Akali wins 6 and the row is Skill at first item; content and packet say Azir wins 6 and Akali wins first item. I cannot ground the content/packet version from the kits — Perfect Execution at 6 is 120s with an execute recast while Azir's level-6 gain is a defensive wall, which argues the OPPOSITE of what the packet says, and Nashor's is Azir's biggest lane spike, which again argues the opposite. Per the chart rule I left both rows rather than move a side I cannot explain. Also note content.mid contained the literal token 'Skill-check', which looks like a chart-token find/replace leak rather than intended prose; it is gone in the rewrite. breakdown.late left as generic Azir boilerplate — nothing in Akali's kit gives me a specific late-game statement I can source.
